saw_lines: Buyers of home eye tests want proof the numbers are right before they trust a device with their eyesight.
So the sale is lost early, when a stranger lands on your ad with no proof or offer to act on.
Your 6 of 8 Meta ads open on the “if your vision feels off” line. Test three new openers: check numbers before buying glasses, reading glasses at home, a free color test.
ads_1: Glasses numbers and color tests as openers, tested against the current line
